overview: Regular/CFL/DCFL/recursive/RE languages ki closure under union, intersection, complement, concatenation, Kleene star.
coreConcept: Closure table yaad rakho: Regular sab me closed; CFL union/concat/star me closed, intersection/complement me nahi.
hinglishExplanation: CFL intersection regular language ke saath CFL hi rehta hai. DCFL complement me closed. RE complement me closed nahi. Recursive complement me closed.
formalDefinition: Closure table yaad rakho: Regular sab me closed; CFL union/concat/star me closed, intersection/complement me nahi.
importantProperties: Regular: closed under all standard operations.
CFL: union, concatenation, Kleene star, reversal; NOT intersection, complement.
RE: union, intersection, concatenation, star; not complement.
